# go-modern-fmt-appendf

**Since:** Go 1.19

## Summary

Use fmt.Appendf when appending formatted text to a byte slice and an intermediate fmt.Sprintf string is unnecessary.

## Details

fmt.Appendf writes formatted output directly into a byte slice.
It is useful when code is already accumulating []byte and the extra string allocation from fmt.Sprintf is not needed.

## Examples

### Before

```go
buf = append(buf, []byte(fmt.Sprintf("x=%d", x))...)
```

### After

```go
buf = fmt.Appendf(buf, "x=%d", x)
```
